seal.statement: The fresh-seed bootstrap release owner may overlap independent partition cohort cutovers in a bounded admission window while retaining the original SQL_TRANSACTIONS-first priority, deterministic input-order accountability, one original shared 1000/5000ms deadline, exactly one intent per partition, and all per-cohort authentic membership/control pre/post safety. It must await and account for every admitted operation before reporting startup success/failure, so no orphaned release runs survive a refusal.
